scenes.headline: How Rigel mixes Mamba-2, attention and experts
scenes.sub: 2.3B parameters, 360M active, trained on whichever chips were free
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Hazel! Here's how Rigel fits together, and how one run hopped across five kinds of chip.

scenes.text: Three of every four layers are Mamba-2, with a fixed-size state. Every feed-forward block is 128 tiny experts, and a token uses 2.
scenes.say: Three of every four layers are Mamba-2, with a fixed-size state. Every feed-forward block is tiny experts.

steps.say: Forty layers: a mixer, then a feed-forward block.
Three mixers in a row are Mamba-2, each carrying a fixed-size state.
The fourth is attention, for exact lookups, with a window so its cache stops growing.
Then a hundred twenty-eight small experts. Each token uses two.

parts.note: keep a fraction of the old state
parts.say: F of t, between zero and one, decides how much of the old state survives.
Then the token writes in a key times a value: linear attention with a decay.
Training runs it in chunks, so almost all of it is matrix multiplies.

steps.say: The authors' drawing: three Mamba-2 layers, then attention, each followed by experts.
On the left, attention. The minus sign is XSA, removing each token's own value.

scenes.title: One run, five kinds of chip

items.say: One PyTorch model file runs on GPUs and TPUs alike.
Each kind of chip got its own kernels.

items.text: FP16 with loss scaling on V100
items.say: Old V100s can't do BF16, so they ran FP16 with loss scaling.

items.text: Move the run when chips free up
items.say: The run moved clusters as chips became free.

scenes.label: of 2.35B stored parameters, summed from the safetensors header
scenes.note: 86% of the stored weights are experts
scenes.say: From the weights: two point three five billion stored, three hundred sixty-four million active.

scenes.title: Rigel's compute as a share of Llama's
scenes.say: Under one percent of Llama's compute? Charged for its teacher's run, yes. For its own run, about four percent.

scenes.text: Fixed state for most layers, capacity in tiny experts, and one model file that every chip can run.
scenes.mark: one model file that every chip can run
scenes.say: Fixed state for most layers, capacity in tiny experts, one model file for every chip.
